import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from helpers import lda_fit
from scipy.special import erf
gelu=lambda x: 0.5*x*(1+erf(x/np.sqrt(2)))
d=np.load('base_feats.npz'); y=d['y']; n=len(y)
def ln(x): x=x-x.mean(1,keepdims=True); return x/np.sqrt((x**2).mean(1,keepdims=True)+1e-12)
def stdz(X): return (X-X.mean(0))/(X.std(0)+1e-6)
Z0=stdz(ln(d['cls11']+2*d['mean11']))
def run(gam, alpha=0.3, lam=0.01, seeds=3):
    accs=[]
    for seed in range(seeds):
        f=np.random.default_rng(seed).permutation(n)%5; P=np.zeros((n,8))
        for j in range(5):
            tr=f!=j; te=~tr
            Wt,b=lda_fit(Z0[tr],y[tr],alpha)
            # orthonormal basis of discriminant directions
            Q,_=np.linalg.qr(Wt.T)  # 768x8
            Zp=Z0+gam*(Z0@Q)@Q.T
            K=gelu(Zp@Zp.T/768)
            T=np.eye(8)[y[tr]]; bb=T.mean(0)
            A=np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(tr,tr)]+lam*np.eye(tr.sum()),T-bb); P[te]=K[np.ix_(te,tr)]@A+bb
        accs.append((P.argmax(1)==y).mean())
    return np.mean(accs)
for gam in [0,0.5,1,2]:
    print(gam, round(run(gam),4))
